frequency_question: How often do proposed industrial subsidy schemes successfully meet formal notification and implementation criteria within the targeted 12-month window?
membership_rule: Includes any formally announced heavy vehicle, manufacturing, or clean transport financing scheme by a central economic ministry; excludes minor amendments, advisory guidelines, or schemes lacking direct financial subsidy and credit guarantee components.

skeleton: Total named major industrial financing/subsidy policy rollouts by central economic ministries examined against meeting formal gazette/subsidy criteria within the target timeframe.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 6 named cases equals 83.3 percent base rate satisfaction given policy progression.
validity_reason: Current bureaucratic rulemaking procedures and policy implementation speeds for industrial subsidies remain stable under the existing administrative framework.
